tools.name: search_devart_knowledge_sources
tools.description: Perform semantic search in the documentation and other knowledge sources and return the most relevant chunks for a given query. A chunk is a self-contained snippet of text from a single page and includes its source URL, title, product name, content type, and markdown content. Chunks are returned in descending order of relevance. If the knowledge sources do not contain relevant information, returned chunks may be weakly related or unrelated.

product_name.description: Optional product name to filter results. Call the product names tool to discover valid values.

tools.name: get_devart_product_names
tools.description: Returns the complete list of all product names available in the knowledge base. Use this to discover valid product names before filtering search results.
